Let \(f\) be a continuous function defined on the closed interval \(-4 \leq x \leq 6\). The graph of \(f\), consisting of four
line segments, is shown above. Let \(G\) be the function defined by \(G(x)=\int_{0}^{x} f(t) d t\).
(a) On what open intervals is the graph of \(G\) concave up? Give a reason for your answer.
(b) Let \(P\) be the function defined by \(P(x)=G(x) \cdot f(x)\). Find \(P^{\prime}(3)\).
(c) Find \(\lim _{x \rightarrow 2} \frac{G(x)}{x^{2}-2 x}\).
(d) Find the average rate of change of \(G\) on the interval [-4, 2]. Does the Mean Value Theorem guarantee a
value \(c,-4<c<2\), for which \(G^{\prime}(c)\) is equal to this average rate of change? Justify your answer.
